description: This is a Java source file implementing the BankingService interface as BankingServiceImpl. It provides methods for managing customers, accounts, transactions, and fund transfers within a banking application, utilizing Spring framework annotations and repository components.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of BankingService interface; provides methods for customer and account management, transfers, and transaction retrieval in a banking system.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customers and converts them into CustomerDetails domain objects.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record based on provided customer details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds a customer by their customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by their customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds an account by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account for a specified customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Transfers funds between accounts for a customer.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions associated with a specific account.
